title: kc-plan-receipt v1
description: What plan-flow hands to ship-flow. Canonical JSON: keys sorted, UTF-8, no trailing whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, null kept. receipt_sha256 is computed over the canonical form with the receipt_sha256 key removed. Captain rationale (verbatim answers, station tables) lives in a separate rationale file referenced by rationale_sha256; it is not part of this receipt.

code_repo.description: owner/name of the repository the Issues deliver into

user_value.description: '[persona] obtains [observable outcome]', one line, under 30 words; the Linear description's first sentence is projected from this

hypothesis.description: epic-hypothesis if/then; the bet, distinct from user_value

wedge.description: office-hours Target User & Narrowest Wedge: one named human and one this-week version

outcome_hash.description: sha256(name + '\n' + content) as linear-admission.py computes planning-outcome

journey.description: the recordable journey this milestone completes; empty milestones array means one implicit milestone = the project

branch.description: Linear's exact branchName (it truncates); pin on this value only

milestone.description: milestone id or null when the project is the implicit milestone

body.description: the canonical Development Brief body exactly as admitted; the worker receives this verbatim

edges.description: [blocker, blocked] pairs from Linear blockedBy; must be a DAG

dispatch_order.description: topological order of every issue key exactly once; each edge's blocker precedes its blocked

digest.description: sha256 of the full lint report kept in the rationale file

premises.description: office-hours Phase 3 premises the Captain agreed to; structured ids only, prose lives in the rationale file

market_signal.description: optional; audience=self may carry score null; the rating agent's report lives in the rationale file

rationale_sha256.description: sha256 of the rationale file: station tables, Captain verbatim answers, full lint output, market-signal report
